description: Claim every claimable acceptance criterion of one story in a single call, so the whole story is built together. The response lists what was claimed, what was skipped and why, and a context pack for each claimed criterion (the same pack vibemap_get_criterion_context returns). All or nothing: if another agent wins a race, nothing is left claimed by this call. Packs that do not fit are listed as omitted; fetch them one by one.

includeSource.description: Include the source of related code in each pack (default false)

name: vibemap_claim_story
